questions.question: Choose the correct greeting:
questions.questionFa: سلام درست را انتخاب کنید:

questions.question: I ______ coffee every morning.
questions.questionFa: من هر صبح قهوه ______ می‌نوشم.

questions.question: ______ a book on the table.
questions.questionFa: ______ روی میز است.

questions.question: What does "apple" mean?
questions.questionFa: معنی «apple» چیست؟

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.questionFa: کدام جمله درست است؟

questions.passage: Tom has a small dog. Every morning he takes it to the park near his house. The dog loves to run, and Tom throws a ball for it.
questions.question: Where does Tom take his dog every morning?
questions.questionFa: تام هر صبح سگش را کجا می‌برد؟

questions.question: He ______ his homework yesterday.
questions.questionFa: او دیروز تکالیفش را ______.

questions.question: You ______ see a doctor if it gets worse.
questions.questionFa: اگر بدتر شد ______ دکتر ببینید.

questions.question: This film is much ______ than the last one.
questions.questionFa: این فیلم خیلی ______ از فیلم قبلی است.

questions.question: What is the opposite of "cheap"?
questions.questionFa: متضاد «cheap» چیست؟

questions.question: Choose the correct question for the answer: "The meeting is at nine."
questions.questionFa: برای پاسخ «جلسه ساعت نه است» پرسش درست را انتخاب کنید:

questions.passage: Nina wanted to buy a gift for her mother. She went to the shop and chose a blue scarf. It cost twenty dollars, so she paid with her card.
questions.question: What did Nina buy?
questions.questionFa: نینا چه چیزی خرید؟

questions.question: I ______ in Tehran since 2018.
questions.questionFa: من از سال ۲۰۱۸ در تهران ______.

questions.question: The letter ______ yesterday.
questions.questionFa: نامه دیروز ______ شد.

questions.question: She said she ______ busy at the moment.
questions.questionFa: او گفت که در آن لحظه ______ است.

questions.question: What does "reliable" mean?
questions.questionFa: معنی «reliable» چیست؟

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.questionFa: کدام جمله درست است؟

questions.passage: The train was delayed because of heavy snow. Many passengers waited on the cold platform. The station staff brought hot tea and explained that the train would arrive in an hour.
questions.question: Why was the train delayed?
questions.questionFa: چرا قطار تأخیر داشت؟

questions.question: If I ______ ten minutes earlier, I wouldn't have missed the train.
questions.questionFa: اگر ده دقیقه زودتر ______، قطار را از دست نمی‌دادم.

questions.question: The man ______ car was stolen reported it to the police.
questions.questionFa: مردی که ______ ماشینش دزدیده شد به پلیس گزارش داد.

questions.question: I wish I ______ more time to relax this week.
questions.questionFa: کاش این هفته وقت بیشتری برای استراحت ______.

questions.question: By the time we arrived, the movie ______.
questions.questionFa: وقتی رسیدیم، فیلم از قبل ______ بود.

questions.question: The board decided to ______ the decision until Monday.
questions.questionFa: هیئت تصمیم را تا دوشنبه ______ کرد.

questions.passage: A recent survey found that most employees prefer working from home two days a week. They said they save time on commuting and feel less stressed. However, some managers worry that teamwork becomes harder.
questions.question: What do most employees prefer?
questions.questionFa: بیشتر کارمندان چه چیزی را ترجیح می‌دهند؟
options: Working from home two days a week

questions.question: Never ______ such a complete mess in my life!
questions.questionFa: هرگز در زندگی‌ام چنین آشفتگی‌ای ______!

questions.question: You ______ have told me you were coming — I waited an hour!
questions.questionFa: باید به من می‌گفتی می‌آیی — یک ساعت منتظر ماندم!

questions.question: If he had taken the job, he ______ in Dubai now.
questions.questionFa: اگر آن شغل را قبول کرده بود، الان در دبی ______.

questions.question: Hardly ______ the phone when it rang again.
questions.questionFa: به‌محض اینکه گوشی را گذاشتم، دوباره زنگ خورد.

questions.question: Which word is closest in meaning to "ambiguous"?
questions.questionFa: کدام واژه به «ambiguous» نزدیک‌تر است؟

questions.passage: Critics of the new policy argue that it places too much emphasis on test scores. They claim that schools may neglect creativity and critical thinking. Supporters respond that standardised results help identify struggling students early.
questions.question: What do critics of the new policy argue?
questions.questionFa: منتقدان سیاست جدید چه استدلالی دارند؟
options: Schools may neglect creativity and critical thinking

questions.question: His explanation was concise but rather ______.
questions.questionFa: توضیحش مختصر بود اما تا حدی ______.

questions.question: The senator's remarks were heavy with ______.
questions.questionFa: اظهارات سناتور سرشار از ______ بود.

questions.question: Independent sources ______ the initial hypothesis.
questions.questionFa: منابع مستقل فرضیه اولیه را ______ کردند.

questions.question: The politician's answer was deliberately ______, avoiding any firm commitment.
questions.questionFa: پاسخ سیاستمدار عمداً ______ بود و از هر تعهد مشخصی طفره می‌رفت.

questions.question: The evidence was too ______ to support a conviction.
questions.questionFa: مدارک برای محکومیت خیلی ______ بودند.

questions.passage: The author's argument rests on the assumption that readers share her understanding of irony. Where that assumption fails, the text can seem sincere, and its criticism is easily missed. A careful reader, she suggests, must attend to tone as much as to content.
questions.question: What assumption does the author's argument rest on?
questions.questionFa: استدلال نویسنده بر چه فرضی استوار است؟
options: That readers share her understanding of irony
